onboardingEvidence.scope: The entire unfiltered Siemens Digital Industries Software board, including Siemens EDA and Mendix; not the entire Siemens conglomerate.
onboardingEvidence.provenance: The official Software careers home links /jobs/ and its EDA business board. Its browser requests GET https://prod-search-api.jobsyn.org/api/v1/solr/search?page=1&num_items=10 with X-Origin: jobs.sw.siemens.com.
onboardingEvidence.countEvidence: The same search response used by the official UI publishes pagination.total 753, page_size 10, total_pages 76 and has_more_pages. No keyword, location or business filter is applied.
onboardingEvidence.identityEvidence: Software Engineer(VIP), Taipei, requisition 520661; Senior Product Engineer, Calibre DesignEnhancer, Yerevan, requisition 520007; Senior Product Validation Engineer, Aprisa, Noida. Descriptions identify Siemens EDA.
onboardingEvidence.globalPortalCaveat: Avature global SearchJobs accepts folderOffset (not jobOffset) but offsets above 2000 return no results despite a Next link at 2000. That capped global portal was not certified. The Software board is an independently published official board with its own complete count.
onboardingEvidence.descriptionEvidence: Full descriptions are inline in search jobs[].description. The official detail page also reads microsites.dejobs.org/jobs-sw-siemens-com/data/<GUID>.json.
